_note: V3 board 3.0 lock-encoding contract. Flat ids map RAW; nested ids: percent-encode the NFC-NORMALIZED id (unreserved A-Za-z0-9_.~-, uppercase hex, UTF-8 bytes) + '.' + first 8 hex of sha256 of the NFC-normalized LOWERCASED id (str.lower / Swift lowercased — NOT full casefold; the two implementations must agree byte-for-byte). Locks coalesce exactly when a case/normalization-insensitive filesystem coalesces the session dirs. Python: orchestrator.encode_lock_name; Swift: SessionLayout.encodeLockName. Neither side may 'adjust' this file to pass — that is by definition an encoding bug.
